definitions.meanPerTickSpeed: Mean of the population mean speed at every completed tick, in world widths per tick. Motion is not evidence of adaptation.
definitions.occupiedBins: Number of occupied cells in a fixed 10 by 10 grid of the unit torus at census time.
definitions.capTicks: Number of completed ticks whose ending population equals the configured hard cap.
definitions.maxGeneration: Maximum generation among particles alive at this census, not the historical maximum.
definitions.traitSpread: Population-wide standard deviation across attraction coordinates, including differences between founding families.
definitions.blockedBirths: Repeated eligible birth attempts denied by the population cap, not unique parents.
definitions.maximumEnergyResidual: Maximum absolute sum(particles + food + metabolic losses + death losses - initial energy - renewed food) over completed ticks.
